what: templates-tests-rule allows an integration test to drive a public library function; end-to-end tests still go through the CLI, HTTP or UI.
why: Owner rule after the pilot 1 run (Tom, 2026-10-20, PR #54): integration tests may enter through a public library function, e.g. pilot 1's build_context(); end-to-end tests and just qc still go through the CLI, HTTP or UI. ADR 0002 was rewritten in place and the spec followed it (owner yes: Tom, 2026-10-20).
evidence: Pilot 1 run: a target whose public surface is a library function could not be integration-tested under 'the test drives the app's CLI, HTTP or UI and calls no internal function', which contradicted rewritten ADR 0002.

what: templates-integrate-rule: only a repository created from a template has just integrate; a repository the kit did not create gains no factory recipe, agents run octo-feather-integrate and octo-feather-qc directly.
why: Hand-in repos must stay clean (PR #56, owner approved 2026-10-20); ADR 0017 was rewritten in place to match.
evidence: Pilot 1 (2026-10-20): the hand-in repo gained integrate/qc recipes in its justfile because the spec said every target defines them.

what: Adds a starter verify skill to both templates (row tpl-verify, story, criterion acceptance-starter-verify).
why: Owner decision 2026-10-25 on issue #136: templates ship a starting verify skill.
evidence: templates/python/AGENTS.md and templates/typescript/AGENTS.md declare no verify skill on their Repo skills lines, and neither template has .agents/skills/, so a template-born repository has no scripted drive of its app (issue #136).

what: A repository created from either template also ships a minimal starter spec in docs/specs/ holding the one criterion of its starter command (Spec Chat-valid, one hello criterion), which the verify skill's hello feature file links and whose text its evidence records hash.
why: Evidence records must hash the criterion's own text (quality#acceptance-evidence-record); a template-born repository had no spec, so its verify skill hashed a Markdown link instead. Director ruling 2026-10-27: log as a spec call for the owner at merge.
evidence: Code review round 3 at 58b95ad, blocking [class: incorrect-criterion-hash]: templates/python/.agents/skills/verify-app/scripts/verify-app:239-241 and templates/typescript/.agents/skills/verify-app/scripts/verify-app:246-248 pass a Markdown link as --criterion-text; fresh template repos have no spec, so records hash the link, not the criterion's text, contradicting quality#acceptance-evidence-record and schemas/evidence.v1.schema.json criterion.text_sha256.
